text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S delivered "results" in the 
Takarazuka Kinen. Her performance left a 
deep impression on Zenno Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the spectators are all wildly 
enthusiastic about Tap Dance City. Symboli 
Kris S feels that she lacks that kind of 
fiery heat herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, public interest in Tap Dance 
City surged. What's more, there were still 
people talking passionately about Tanino 
Gimlet even now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S feels that her own running 
has yet to overwrite the memories of the 
crowd's fervor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And she began to question whether simply 
producing "results" was not enough to 
start a "revolution." —The next target was 
her second Tenno Sho (Autumn).
